title: Charming 3 Bedroom Home Near BNA Airport!
description:
Enjoy a  3 bedroom 2 1/2 bathroom home in this centrally located in Nashville. Just minutes from BNA Nashville Airport and downtown Nashville. Whether you’re visiting for a quick get away or work, this property is ideal!!

The space
Please note: This is a three-story home. Your stay includes the entire first and second floors.

The basement is a separate apartment with its own private entrance. It may be occupied during your stay, but there's no interior connection — you won't share any space or entrances with them.

The backyard is not included.

Guest access
Guests do not have access to the backyard
